arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Shapiro argued the state should not force needles on all suspects.
Ms. Saharsky argued officers face certain destruction of critical blood evidence.
Mr. Koester stated quickly securing blood alcohol evidence is incredibly important.
Justice Kennedy questioned if other states' rules are relevant to reasonableness.
